_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what each audience sees.
TO SHOW A TAB TO THE TEAM: move its id into publicSections. That is the
whole change — the nav, the section guard and the data allowlist all read
from here, so nothing can drift out of sync.
dataFiles lists the JSON each section fetches, as regexes matched against
paths relative to dist/data. scripts/prune_data.mjs unions the entries for
publicSections and deletes everything else from a team build, so a section
can never end up visible with its data missing (or hidden with its data
Both audiences are the same app reading the same files, produced by the
same daily run from api.mfapi.in. There is no second dataset.
